purpose: The preview of one stored file in a storage or object browser: a header with the file's glyph, name, type and size, a Download action, and a body that shows the file the way it can be read. An image renders as the image, text as wrapped monospace text, JSON pretty-printed, and any other type a no-preview state that points at Download. Long text is cut at `maxLength` characters with a note that says so. It renders what the app hands it (an image URL, the text it fetched); it fetches nothing.
useWhen: The detail pane or drawer of a file browser when a row is opened (`view/view-file-browser`, an Edge Storage bucket, a KV value).
Showing an uploaded object before it is published or replaced.
Any screen that shows one file and needs a type-aware fallback for files it cannot draw.
avoidWhen: Highlighted source code with tabs and copy — use `CodeBlock`.
A list of files with upload progress — use `FileTokenGroup` or `UploadProgress`.
related: `CodeBlock` — syntax-highlighted code; heavier, for a code sample rather than a stored object.
`EmptyState` — the no-preview and error states inside this component.
`Skeleton` — the loading placeholder inside this component.
`DataTable` — the file list a preview opens from.
bestPractices: Pass `mimeType` from the object's `Content-Type`; leave it empty and the file name's extension decides.
Fetch only the first part of a large text file (a ranged request) and pass `bytes` with the full size, so the header shows the real size while the body shows the first part.
Handle `download` with the app's own signed or authorized URL; the component never builds one.
Pass an object URL (`URL.createObjectURL`) or a short-lived signed URL as `src`; revoke an object URL when the preview closes.
